# rapidyaml

The single-header release of [rapidyaml](https://github.com/biojppm/rapidyaml), used to read and write YAML in C++
(decision A12). Only `ThermoFun/IO/Yaml/Yaml.cpp` includes it.

- Version: 0.16.0, the release asset `rapidyaml.v0.16.0.singlehdr.hpp`, renamed `rapidyaml.hpp`, not changed.
- SHA-256: `0d0b8076174cf62f034406b03529fda542ebc9a17506d3bd6d949aedc4bfa6ab` (the digest that GitHub gives for the asset).
- Licence: MIT, in `LICENSE.txt`. It includes c4core, also MIT.
